meta.title: My Privacy Sanctuary — Spellful
meta.description: Control who can see your profile, find you, message you, and how your information is shared.

header.title: My Privacy Sanctuary
header.subtitle: Control who sees you and how you're found

profileVisibility.title: Profile visibility
profileVisibility.description: Who can view your full profile page

discovery.title: Discovery & search
discovery.description: Control whether others can find you
discovery.suggestionsDesc: Show up in "People you may know" and coven suggestions
discovery.searchDesc: Let other members find you by username or name

presence.title: Presence & online status
presence.description: Control whether others see when you're active
presence.hideDesc: Others won't see the green dot or "Active now" indicator

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: Who can send you direct messages
messaging.everyoneDesc: Any Spellful member can send you a message request.
messaging.covenDesc: Only members you follow can message you directly.
messaging.nobodyDesc: No one can send you new messages. Existing conversations are unaffected.

birthday.title: Birthday
birthday.description: Control how your birthday is shared
birthday.feedDesc: Post a birthday celebration in the Coven Hearth on your birthday

interactions.title: Interactions
interactions.description: Control how others can interact with your profile
interactions.guestbookDesc: Let others leave public messages on your profile
interactions.mentionsDesc: Let others tag you in community posts and replies

notifications.title: Notification privacy
notifications.description: Control what appears on your lock screen
notifications.lockScreenLabel: Hide message content on lock screen
notifications.lockScreenDesc: Show "New message" instead of the sender's name and message text on your device lock screen

blocked.title: Blocked accounts
blocked.description: Members you've blocked cannot see your profile, message you, or interact with your content
blocked.manageLink: Manage blocked accounts in Account Settings

dataRights.text: You can download your data or request account deletion at any time from Account Settings. Read our Privacy Policy to learn exactly what we collect and how long we keep it.
